acquire.detail: Granté sells it from the balcony of his house in Tarrey Town once the From the Ground Up side quest is complete. He only stocks pieces you have already obtained at least once.

acquire.title: Fang and Bone (Kilton)
acquire.detail: Sold by Kilton at the Fang and Bone. He first appears at night at Skull Lake in Akkala, then near most towns from 9:00 PM to 5:00 AM. Trade him monster parts for Mon. Stocked after one Divine Beast is freed.

acquire.title: Starlight Memories, Gerudo Town
acquire.detail: Sold at Starlight Memories, the jeweler in Gerudo Town. The shop opens after you bring Isha 10 Flint in the Tools of the Trade side quest. You must supply the gems as part of the price.

acquire.title: Buried chest at the Spring of Courage
acquire.detail: Read Misko's EX Journal 2 at the Deya Village Ruins to start the quest. At the Spring of Courage in Faron (Shae Katha Shrine), use Magnesis on the chest under the right claw of the dragon statue. Quest: EX Treasure: Merchant Hood.

acquire.detail: Scan the Super Smash Bros. series Sheik amiibo with the amiibo rune. The mask is a random drop from the chest that appears, and each amiibo can only be scanned once per day.

acquire.title: Side quest: The Thunder Helm
acquire.detail: After freeing Divine Beast Vah Naboris, examine the helm beside Riju's throne in Gerudo Town. Complete Tools of the Trade, The Mystery Polluter, Medicinal Molduga and The Search for Barta, then return to Riju, who lends you the helm.
